title: Get S Working End to End
description: Get s working end to end. Dev build fails because framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs WindowMeasure::Slider, UiTreeSectionNode, UiButtonNode, UiSectionNode, and UiTreeNode initializers are missing the new waiting field after waiting-state was mirrored through React controls/trees/wgpu chrome. Fix compile and confirm bun run dev:s (or equivalent) builds plugins end to end.
summary: S studio E2E works: home → double-click Demo Studio → studio workbench (Workflow/Media VFS/Compiled DAG). Fixed Home/Space command_from_action bridges, body_key window-id suffix stripping, HostEffect {kind,value}→external-tag normalization, parseSpaceShellPath /spaces/ (was /studios/), LoadDocument pack/spr via AppChannelClient, scene pack wire decode for editor/node-graph (plus SEMIO_PLUGIN_ONLY rebuild escape).
